dedupe_keys.name: results and code for spatial analysis of future climate risk to stormwater infrastructure

description: Results and code for "Spatial Analysis of Future Climate Risk to Stormwater Infrastructure" is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Butcher, Jonathan (deposited on HydroShare). This resource archives Python code and results supporting the paper "Spatial Analysis of Future Climate Risk to Stormwater Infrastructure". The abstract for this paper follows: Climate change is expected to result in more intense precipitation events that will affect the performance and design requirements of stormwater infrastructure. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2022-12-02 and last updated 2023-05-05; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
